notes.title: Powers update !
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31929865/7ce29a686ac358d49e6cd241f7ecf12b73f2a57a.jpg[/img]

Hello everybody,
We hope you are doing well and we just wanted to share some updates on the game.
We were hard at work to give our little shinobies some powers that could reveal a little bit of their personnalities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31929865/232d59c1dafd843f4300b0a784b6f59069ea8bf1.png[/img]

Aka got the bomb'origami.
You can throw a bomb and make it explode whenever you want or let it explode 3 seconds after launching it

Chairo can make a wood clone of himself that will stop any projectile launched at him, it will stay indefinitely until you decide to pop a new one. 

Murasaki can turn his last thrown shuriken into a toxic sushi that will incapacitate any shinobi eating it, so be careful if you don't have anymore shurikens then you can't use your power.

Ao can pop a controllable water bubble that can deviate any projectile and capture shinobies in it. It last 5 seconds but you can pop it anytime you want. Beware though, while controlling the bubble you are vulnerable

Also added in the update are some minor corrections and the possibility of playing missions up to 4 players compare to 2 before.

[b]REMOTE PLAY TOGETHER[/b]
With the new steam addition of remote play, you can enjoy the game with your friends, thanks to this new feature. And we were surprised how nicely it works! We are quite happy about that actually :)

We hope that this little addition into the game will give you some challenge and some fun to share with your friends. And yes it's free.
Take care all.

- Corbak Games

notes.title: Shinobi Bad Buddies will become free !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, hope your doing good!
We have some news to share with you. As the title said, Shinobi Bad Buddies will become free to acquire on steam in the coming days ːsteamhappyː

There are reasons behind this move and the first one is that we couldn't properly market the game and that it was our very first big project.
We do not come from the AAA sector, we are just gamers that love indie games.
Unfortunately with all of what we have tried to advertise, market, communicate, we failed to actually manage to do it efficiently and this resulted in the non-existent community around Shinobi Bad Buddies.

We did a lot of mistakes regarding that and we acknowledge totally.
This is our fault and we don't want to let the game fall into limbo by keeping it paid if it will not be noticed.
So we thought very hard about it, and it was not a easy decision after 17 months of hardwork and supported by nobody except ourselves, to accept the fact that the strategy needed to be reworked.

That is why we came to the conclusion that giving it for free and let it be accessible for whoever wants to play it, was the best solution for us.
After all, what we want is to make games accessible for all.

For the people who already bought the game, we want to thank you kindly and heartly, it means a lot to us and we hope you were not disapointed by it.
Of course, this doesn't mean we are not going to make another big project, but for the time being we will focus on smaller projects that will be free and communicate with you as much as we can.

All in all we regret nothing and we had a blast making this game and bringing it to you! :)

We really hope you will give it a try, enjoy it and share with us some feedbacks and improvements for any future enhancement if that ever comes to the table.
For the time being we will focus on smaller projects so you can always follow these here on [url=https://gamejolt.com/@CorbakGames] Gamejolt [/url] [url=https://corbak-games.itch.io/] itchio [/url]

Thank you !

Devlog #9 | v1.1.0

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/dcf125f1f1f46342f7e0ec96e5b94ce73fb2d3dc.png[/img]

Hello everyone!
We hope you had a great happy new year and a good start for 2019 ! :)
 
As for us, we were hard at work focusing on bug fixing, getting back and forth with beta-testers and reducing technical debt to make the game more pleasant to play.
But as we were slaying some bugs we also made some major improvements and added some cool weapons to the game too!
 
2018 was a long year for both of us and Shinobi Bad Buddies was born in August 2017.
As it is our first big game we made so many mistakes and learned through all the process.
But all in all, this provided us with invaluable experience that will help us to make better things in the future :)
 
It is time to think about the future and that's why we are proud to deliver this update and start to focus on new things !
We are not letting down Shinobi Bad Buddies and will continue to be close to the community and improve things. But we are going to allocate more time for new things, 2019 will be exciting!

Also, thank you very much to anybody who got the game, it really helps us. And thank you very much also to the beta-testers who helped us to make the game more pleasant and more enjoyable :) (you are in the credits)
 
We made a discord server for the game, feel free to join in and say hi, talk with us, report bugs if you are someone who got the game and let's have fun !

[u]New HUD[/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/b4fcde66c0979a585449ccba1bdf5fa404ba7217.png[/img]

[u]New mission menu[/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/c5a23529cdce3fbd16458bf09443483c00a7dd32.png[/img]
We decided to rework the menu design in order to make it clearer. We had to do this as we have reworked the collectible unlocking process to add more hats, the new weapons and things that we might add in future updates. So each mission unlock a new hat and upon finishing a row of mission it unlocks a new weapon.
 
[u]Weapons[/u]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/ec10c295f363926cd8b6d4765950984ac00ba8fa.png[/img]

Shinobi Bad Buddies is finally live!
We are so happy and proud to present you the game.

It has been a long year, we worked hard, and tirelessly to create the game as we have imagined it. And as we release it today, we will continue to enhance it and deliver a better experience for you.

notes.title: Sorry, no release today.....but soon!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/4151aa65bd60ba4ea0fda71981a186ff2a0918a4.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,
Well how can I say this?
Okay the game is not going out today… and we are sorry for that.
(it’s a relief to have just said that)

For the few of you who follow us you must be wondering why, right? Well because we were living in a cave these last few weeks to finish the first version of the game and as we finished it yesterday, like late, we went out and saw that it was the autumn sale on steam…

Yeahh! Happy Thanksgiving ! Happy black friday! And happy us that were living under a rock !

So that means that if we release the game today, we would be thrown right in the abyss of steam. Yup. Just asked steam about it and they strongly recommend us to wait for the end of the sales.

So no need to tell you that we really suck at marketing. I mean it’s our weak spot and we acknowledge that. But to miss out that it was black friday….I think we can say that we are really bad at it ! (We are not proud, we must work on this issue and slay it!)

So the new release date will be on wednesday the 28th of november. And we are sorry for that little delay.
We really hope that you understand us and that you will be around that date when we will release the 1.0.0 finally :) 

We will take this delay to hunt the last bugs and make the game more fluid. Anyway we are going to continue working on it so it’s not all sadness and such :)

Anyway. Happy Thanksgiving everyone, and see you on the 28th of november!

Cheers

- Corbak Games

notes.title: Closed Beta-test rolling !
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,
We are happy to announce that Shinobi Bad Buddies entered Beta-testing !

We are finishing the game with what we had in mind
During the course of the development, we had to change the original idea of what SBB would look like. It was a difficult choice, but we succeeded in implementing a story that would not have been possible with the first version of the game.

We are very proud of what we have achieved so far for the game.
As we are independant, and passionate about making games, we wanted to offer the best experience possible.

That is why we had to remove some planned multiplayer features such as:

[list]
[*]Specific hero powers
[*]Online multiplayer
[*]Weapons
[/list]

That was the cost to create a story mode in solo.
We have decided to ship the first version of the game with this content.
We think that the solo experience will ensure that anyone who buys the game will have something interesting to do even if there are not many players.
The good news is that the game will have a story and the price will not be too much higher compared to the early access price, it will stay affordable :)

We want to thank you, who supported us this long year and who bought our game. This means a lot for us.
Stay tuned for the trailer and the release date that we will soon announce !

- Corbak Games

notes.title: Info Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/d5266d7499e113f295292435d7497d4e7fc5ac8c.jpg[/img]

Hello everyone,
In the last weeks we worked a lot on what the future of Shinobi Bad Buddies will be. We gave this a lot of thoughts and we have decided to bring new changes to our game to give it more meaning.

We realized that with all the mechanics we developed until know, and seeing that the gameplay was the main component of our game, just creating little missions was not enough to experience all the gameplay mechanics we implemented.
We decided to bring a little story-driven experience to the game and relocate the current missions objectives in the local multiplayer for fun when you have friends around.

This will bring more variety missions in the multiplayer experience while having a story to discover solo or in a co-op mode.

We also decided that an online multiplayer wasn’t required at this stage and that we would put all of our efforts into the story experience we want to provide.

We are very proud of our gameplay mechanics and the mood of the game, but we feel that our simple mission system currently lacks of purpose.

That is why we will focus all our efforts to create a story and a coherent world for you to discover. Most of the features we had in the roadmap will be included in the story but will most likely be different from what we first had in mind when we described them.

For example the ninja powers that we were working on until now would most likely not be usable in your first run through the game, but unlockable in the story or in a “new game plus” mode when you replay the story with more difficulty and more powers. This is just an example of what we will change, what is important is that we want to create the best immersion possible with our story and we will use all the features we planned so far to do so.

notes.title: Team mode !
notes.notes:
Devlog #5 | 0.3.0

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/bb145f633b6bd81a01aca76d68a1745bddff386c.png[/img]

Hello everyone !
In this update we present you a little functionality that you can find in multiplayer mode now, the team mode !
Before you could fight only for yourself but now you are finally able to fight as a team with your buddy against other buddies, or against the AI.

[h1]Double jump[/h1]
You can now double jump in the game, it is available to anyone and we think that this will make the gameplay more dynamic.
I hope you will like it and if you have anything to share or any feedback, don’t hesitate we will listen!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/b5a126068499ab2532c3b8ef1e0e3f3216ec4802.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/64dfed8f09220e4686ba43fca21459c6e8350d6b.png[/img][/url]
[h1]Corner grab[/h1]
As it was difficult to actually grab some corner we added a little thing that would make you grab any corner more easily, whether you are wall riding or just grabbing floating platforms.
This will allow more tactical movement while you play

[h1]Climb down the rope[/h1]
As in the early versions you could climb up, we added the possibility to climb it down too. It was a choice at first to not let you climb down cause you would just let loose the hook, but we thought that it would be nice to actually just add it if you want to sneak behind enemies without making any sound.

[h1]Removing race mode[/h1]
Yes, we decided to cut it from the vanilla game. It is something we have been thinking for a while and it was too much work for not much fun. We need for the race mode to redo the level a second time in order to adapt it and even though we did that for the 3 first levels, things were missing in this mode to make it really fun. Once one player is in first position, it became really hard for the others to actually win the race. Not much traps or level design to make it really interesting.
So we decided to drop it for now and we will rethink later on on how to implement new modes that would coexist with the vision we have for the game. We would like to add quality content over quantity and make it pleasant to play.

We hope this update will bring you more pleasure while playing, and hope to hear from you if you have any suggestions :)

[*]Improvements
[list]
[*]fixed collision between team members during co-op
[*]changed the the wall jump force and the jump force
[*]added double jump
[*]implementation of wall ride grab when you arrive at a corner
[*]changed the logic of by passing small steps. Added small stairs where needed for little steps.
[*]speed-up the rope climbing
[*]fixed revive glitch and the indicator in the dialog bubble
[*]you can now climb down on the rope
[*]implemented team selection in the menu
[*]AI can’t get dropped shurikens in missions
[/list]

[*]things we changed
[list]
[*]removed race mode
[/list]

-Corbak Games

notes.title: Missions !
notes.notes:
Devlog #4 | 0.2.0

We have been hard at work to be able to bring you some new interesting features in this new update. And as you guessed it, it is related to the mission mode!

[h1]First things first[/h1]
In the base game there was only two missions available: [b]BENTO[/b] and [b]RAMPAGE[/b] (ex-ASSASSINATE)
Now there are 3 new missions: [b]THIEF[/b], [b]RESCUE[/b] and [b]TARGET[/b]

[b]BENTO[/b]: You need to to gather all the sushis
[b]RAMPAGE[/b]: You need to kill everybody in the level
[b]THIEF[/b]: You need to steal a specific asset while not being spotted
[b]RESCUE[/b]: You need to rescue a buddy
[b]TARGET[/b]: You need to specifically find someone and kill him

There will be a lot more polishing during the development of the game.
And this is a good thing to start with to let you play around with new types of missions while we continue to enhance the experience. We will wait to have all the pieces of the gameplay before we build the actual story of the game with appropriate missions to unlock cool gameplay elements as you play through the story.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/850798d06bcd16115e3ddbdd9a0518dc5fc4966b.png[/img]

[h1]AI Logic[/h1]
As we ship this update with new missions, we gave the AI more personality and a bit of a logic. They now can see if one of their buddies fell into their sight, check on them and check their patrol before returning to their standing point

Of course, as the game continue to grows, we will shape more and more the AI so that it suits our cute world, and gives you some funny interactions during your game :)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/96049b1b2c5b349bf662ad88e5a8454e099d33e0.jpg[/img]

[h1]Co-op reviving[/h1]
Now when you play missions with friends, if one of them is killed during the mission, you can revive him with the action button.
We thought of implementing it because it was a bit boring to watch your friend getting all the credits when you took a shuriken for him … yea.

notes.title: Missions !
notes.notes:
Devlog #4 | 0.2.0

We have been hard at work to be able to bring you some new interesting features in this new update. And as you guessed it, it is related to the mission mode!

[h1]First things first[/h1]
In the base game there was only two missions available: [b]BENTO[/b] and [b]RAMPAGE[/b] (ex-ASSASSINATE)
Now there are 3 new missions: [b]THIEF[/b], [b]RESCUE[/b] and [b]TARGET[/b]

[b]BENTO[/b]: You need to to gather all the sushis
[b]RAMPAGE[/b]: You need to kill everybody in the level
[b]THIEF[/b]: You need to steal a specific asset while not being spotted
[b]RESCUE[/b]: You need to rescue a buddy
[b]TARGET[/b]: You need to specifically find someone and kill him

There will be a lot more polishing during the development of the game.
And this is a good thing to start with to let you play around with new types of missions while we continue to enhance the experience. We will wait to have all the pieces of the gameplay before we build the actual story of the game with appropriate missions to unlock cool gameplay elements as you play through the story.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/850798d06bcd16115e3ddbdd9a0518dc5fc4966b.png[/img]

[h1]AI Logic[/h1]
As we ship this update with new missions, we gave the AI more personality and a bit of a logic. They now can see if one of their buddies fell into their sight, check on them and check their patrol before returning to their standing point

Of course, as the game continue to grows, we will shape more and more the AI so that it suits our cute world, and gives you some funny interactions during your game :)
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/96049b1b2c5b349bf662ad88e5a8454e099d33e0.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Split Screen & Radar
notes.notes:
Devlog #2 | 0.1.0

Hello everyone !
Since the launch we have been super busy to deliver one of the key functionality of the roadmap. The Split Screen ! (yayy) together with a radar that lets you know points of interests when you can’t see them in your screen.

Split Screen lets you share the same screen in 2,3 or 4 blocks if you are 4 players. You will still be able to play on the same shared screen by toggling the option in-game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/1f6eb8caaf484cf1fb15c49e96c073e0b9f7654b.jpg[/img]

The radar:
We decided to add small indications on the edge of the screen that act as a radar and show you an mission objectives. We thought about this functionality to allow the player to get quickly points of interests and let him play his way. Nevertheless you can still toggle off this functionality in the option in-game.
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/d9b712ff624f0ebfefef54cb8dc5386c6a768d19.jpg[/img]

You can toggle on & off the Split Screen mode and the radar from the settings menu in-game. We made these settings available if you prefer to play without knowing where are the points of interests and make the game harder :)

We also fixed a range of issues, here is the list:
[list]
    [*]New Features
[list]
    [*]Split Screen ! (option inside in-game settings)
[*]Radar ! (option inside in-game settings)
[/list] 
    [*]Improvements
[list]
    [*]Walk button for keyboard control
[*]Improved HUD when player is KO
[*]Menu improvements (navigation flow, AI selection, player selection)
[*]Better 3D sound effects
[*]Improved IA patrols
[*]Added number of kills in end game stats
[/list] 
    [*]Bug Fixes
[list]
    [*]Fixed shuriken crossing enemies in contact
[*]Fixed mission finished popups
[*]Fixed look up and down conflict with walking
[/list] 

-Corbak Games

notes.title: Development ROADMAP
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31929865/7548342ff230a16fe83832e50c694d6b9bef8dcc.png[/img]

Hello Shinobies! 

We will post our dev roadmap as we build the game so that you guys know what we are currently working on and what will developed next! These are the main big features that we want to implement. We will create specific discussions for the ones we need specific inputs from you, but you are welcome to launch a discussion on any of them in advance !

So here is our current roadmap for after the release of the early access:

- Improve Solo/Coop missions (add more types of missions)
- Split Screen (you will have the choice between shared or split screen)
- Steam Leaderboards
- Teams : you will be able to play in teams in all multiplayer modes
- Forest theme with 3 new levels
- Ninja powers 
- Waterfall theme with 3 new levels
- Weapons
- Steam Achievements
- More eye candy bonuses and Mission progression rework
- Online multiplayer
- Steam trading cards
- Mac version
- Linux Version

All of these are our main objectives and the main vision of what the game would have. And we are really happy to share that with you !

You can follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/CorbakGames]Twitter[/url] and  [url=https://www.facebook.com/ShinobiBadBuddies/]Facebook[/url] if you wish for the latest development news or some sneak peaks :)

Cheers !

- Corbak Games
